acceptance: Tool discovery is namespaced, deterministic, bounded and does not load entire catalogs unnecessarily.

positive.fixture: stable order under shuffled insertion; page size does not change the listing; a namespace listing decodes only its own contracts; construction decodes nothing

negative.fixture: an all-withheld or all-unscoped catalog cannot make a page scan more than 4x its size; hostile cursors; unverified, deprecated, proposed and unwitnessed contracts are never emitted on any surface

versions.primitive: cursor format c1; MCP list cursor t1

security_and_source_permissions: Hidden operations are indistinguishable from unknown ones to a caller lacking the scope.
performance_memory_storage: 10000-entry catalog: index 34.4 ms and 7.7 MB; one cold page of 50 evaluated 14.7 ms and 4.7 MB (stub validator).
